social_circle.name: Denise Amos

demographics.occupation: Home-health aide and former certified nursing assistant
demographics.education: High school graduate with nursing assistant certificate

background.how_they_met: Denise is Carolyn's mother and raised her in Sumiton in a close Black Southern church-centered family.
background.why_close: Carolyn calls her when worried, prays with her, sees her regularly, and shares family, church, food, health, and voting concerns with her.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm and practical, often texting in full sentences with prayer language, reminders, and check-in messages.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether Carolyn made it home safely after early routes or bad weather.
Prayer requests, church announcements, and family health updates about Miss Lottie and Denise's knee pain.
Local election reminders and talking through candidates before voting.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Carolyn's closest family includes her mama Denise and that Denise is the person she calls when worried or needing prayer. Q11 says her mama visits most often. Q23 says Carolyn talks with her mama about candidates.

social_circle.name: Tasha Coleman

demographics.education: High school graduate with medical office certificate

background.how_they_met: They met through local church and fitness circles, then became closer through weekly Zumba and mutual emotional support.
background.why_close: Tasha is Carolyn's first friend to vent to, keeps her accountable for Zumba, and shows up during stressful weeks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast, casual texter who uses jokes, voice notes, laughing emojis, and short encouraging nudges.

recent_text_topics: Tuesday Zumba plans and pushing Carolyn not to skip class after long delivery days.
Venting about work stress, bills, sleep, and not comparing themselves to friends' timelines.
Karaoke night ideas, church brunch plans, and joking about who is bringing food.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Tasha as one of Carolyn's closest friends and says Tasha goes to Zumba with her most Tuesdays. Q07 also says Carolyn usually calls Tasha first when she needs to vent. Q44 says Tasha made Carolyn go to Zumba during a rough week.

social_circle.name: Marcus Amos

demographics.occupation: Diesel mechanic and warehouse maintenance worker
demographics.education: High school graduate with vocational diesel and mechanical training

background.how_they_met: Marcus is Carolyn's father and raised her in Sumiton, teaching her vehicle basics and confidence around trucks and tools.
background.why_close: Carolyn relies on him for car trouble, route advice, and practical support tied to driving and machinery.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, practical texts with direct advice, fewer emojis, and occasional phone calls when an issue needs explaining.

recent_text_topics: Carolyn's recent brake-pad and sensor repair and whether the car sounded right afterward.
Advice about difficult routes, truck inspections, and listening for vehicle problems.
Family football plans and what time Carolyn is stopping by after church or work.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Marcus is Carolyn's daddy and the person she contacts if her car makes a sound or she needs route advice. Q44 says she called her dad about the car during a stressful week. Q106 says he worked as a diesel mechanic and taught her vehicle skills.

social_circle.name: Tre Amos

demographics.education: High school graduate with some vocational coursework

background.how_they_met: Tre is Carolyn's younger brother; they grew up together in their parents' Sumiton household.
background.why_close: They tease each other, share family history, and Carolyn feels protective of him while he is still figuring himself out.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Casual, slang-heavy texter who sends memes, quick check-ins, and playful food-related requests.

recent_text_topics: Asking what Carolyn cooked and whether he can stop by for leftovers.
Alabama football talk and joking during family gatherings.
Political and racial-justice posts, especially when Tre is angry or posting more online.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Carolyn's closest family includes her younger brother Tre and that they tease each other a lot. Q11 says her brother drops by if food is involved. Q30 says her brother gets angry faster and posts more online about racism and policing.

social_circle.name: Brianna Lewis

demographics.occupation: Freelance digital artist and part-time print shop employee
demographics.education: Some community college with graphic design coursework

background.how_they_met: They met through local art circles and became close because both paint and make digital art.
background.why_close: Brianna shares Carolyn's creative side and gives her someone to talk with about painting, commissions, social media posts, and local art opportunities.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Thoughtful texter who sends image references, screenshots, art-event links, and longer encouraging messages.

recent_text_topics: Carolyn's abstract painting with red, yellow, and black shapes after a stressful week.
Finding a local place where Carolyn might eventually show her art.
Sharing Instagram art inspiration, digital illustration ideas, and possible small commission pricing.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Brianna as one of Carolyn's closest friends and says Brianna paints and does digital art too. Q07 says the friend group does karaoke, board game nights, brunch, and photo drives. Q48 says Carolyn uses Instagram for art and follows illustrators.
